title: Aria's Daily Vlog (2)
阿莉亚的日常Vlog（2）

sentences: Hi, this is Aria!
嗨，我是阿莉亚！
Welcome back to my channel!
欢迎回到我的频道！
It's lunchtime now.
现在是午餐时间。
Tommy and I are on the way to a restaurant on an empty stomach.
汤米和我正空着肚子在去餐厅的路上。
We thought that we would order some fast food like pizza or burger because we were really hungry.
我们原以为会点一些快餐比如比萨或汉堡，因为我们真的饿了。
But we eventually decided to have some healthy food.
但我们最终决定吃一些健康的食物。
Now we are sitting at a restaurant.
现在我们正坐在餐厅里。
The waiter just brought us two glasses of mineral water and the lunch menu.
服务员刚刚给我们端来了两杯矿泉水和午餐菜单。
For starters, we decide to try their famous fish soup and egg salad.
作为前菜，我们决定尝试他们著名的鱼汤和鸡蛋沙拉。
For main courses, I would like to have a steak which goes with chips and fried mushrooms while Tommy wants a Sunday roast.
作为主菜，我想要牛排配薯条和炸蘑菇，而汤米想要星期天烤肉。
Have you heard of Sunday roast?
你听说过星期天烤肉吗？
Here it is.
这就是。
As you see, it's a traditional British main meal.
如你所见，这是一道传统的英式主餐。
It is usually served with roast meat and boiled potatoes.
它通常搭配烤肉和水煮土豆供应。
You can choose from chicken, lamb, pork or beef along with different kinds of sauces.
您可以选择鸡肉、羊肉、猪肉或牛肉，搭配不同种类的酱汁。
Vegetables such as carrots, beans and broccoli can also be part of the dish.
蔬菜如胡萝卜、豆类和西兰花也可以成为这道菜的一部分。
Yum, it tastes really good!
嗯，味道真好！
It's already half past two.
已经两点半了。
And we just bought two cups of coffee at our favourite cafe.
我们刚刚在我们最喜欢的咖啡馆买了两杯咖啡。
I think we have eaten too much and we are too full now.
我想我们吃得太多了，现在太饱了。
We decide to have a walk and drop by the supermarket to get some stuff for tonight's supper and tomorrow's breakfast.
我们决定去散散步，顺便去超市买一些今晚晚餐和明天早餐的东西。
We finally get back home!
我们终于回到家了！
We get some bread and sausages to make sandwiches, some jam, and a large bottle of milk.
我们买了一些面包和香肠做三明治，一些果酱，还有一大瓶牛奶。
Thank you for watching!
感谢观看！
Please leave a comment below and hope to see you soon!
请在下方留言，希望很快见到您！

words: 一顿饭；（一顿所吃的）食物

我点了一杯啤酒和一份三明治。
What shall we have for lunch?
After the main course, would you like some dessert?
吃完主菜后，您想来点甜点吗？
How would you like your steak done?
您的牛排要煎到几成熟？
Breakfast is served between 7 and 10 a.m.
早餐供应时间是7点到10点。

We'll have an early supper tonight
今天我们要早点吃晚饭。
